title: MCP Fundamentals
description: Understand the Model Context Protocol and how it standardizes how AI backends expose data, tools, and prompts.
longDescription: Model Context Protocol is an open standard for connecting AI assistants to systems. This module explains the protocol architecture, transport options, resource and tool patterns, and how MCP compares to traditional REST and GraphQL APIs for AI workflows.
whatYouLearn: Explain what MCP solves and when to use it
Identify the roles of MCP host, client, and server
Choose between stdio, HTTP, and SSE transports
Model resources, prompts, and tools in an MCP server
Compare MCP with REST and GraphQL for AI use cases
